mina cho: Hey team — first day here! Quick checklist Q: who to ping for HubSpot seat, Intercom CS access, Dialpad voicemail transfer? Also where do I find the CS playbook, handoff checklist, and SOC2 brief? Thanks!

sev sales-ops: welcome Mina! Filed HubSpot ticket `SO-10022` and Intercom `CS-INT-10023`. Dialpad VM transfer needs the old number + preferred caller ID  DM me. CS playbook + handoff checklist: https://notion.redwood/sales/cs/playbook and https://notion.redwood/sales/cs/handoff-checklist. SOC2 brief: https://redwood.internal/compliance/soc2-summary.pdf

ada it: @mina cho for HubSpot we need your Okta display name and laptop hostname. Intercom auto-provisions after HubSpot SSO; make sure you're logged into Okta in the same browser. For Dialpad include timezone for correct working hours routing.

mina cho: Sent DM with Okta name and hostname (MINA-LAP-05). For Dialpad VM transfer old number is +1-206-555-0147. Do CS seats get conversation routing to a shared inbox by default? Also any privacy/recording opt outs I should know about?

liam cs: Yes — new CS seats are added to `cs-north` shared inbox by default. We use tag `handoff-ready` for sales -> CS. Call recording is enabled org-wide but transcripts are only shared with consent; you can disable transcript sharing in your profile and recordings still store for ops. DM me if you want auto-assign rules.

erica enablement: Playbook is the canonical source. Quick links: one-pagers (integrations): https://notion.redwood/sales/1pagers/integrations, battlecards: https://notion.redwood/sales/battlecards. Handoff email template (pasteable):
Subject: Intro: [Company] — quick context
Body: Hi Team,
• Problem we saw: [1 line]
• What we demoed: [1 line]
• Next step requested: [2 options/times]
Thanks,
[AE name] — keep it <= 5 sentences.

onboarding-bot: Welcome mina cho! New-hire checklist: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/mina-cho  Status: HubSpot (pending), Intercom (pending), Dialpad (queued).

sev sales-ops: HubSpot seat active ✅ — you should see pipelines and contact logging in ~5m. Intercom seat provisioned ✅ and added to `cs-north`. Dialpad voicemail transfer scheduled for 11:00. We'll CC you on the support ticket.

mina cho: Confirmed HubSpot + Intercom access, seeing conversations and pipelines. Thanks for the fast help! One last ask: where are the cheat-sheets for quick answers on pricing, latency, and private deploys?

erica enablement: Pasteable quick lines: 1) Price: "Most customers see token cost improvements after batching and cache tuning; we can share a tailored estimate in 1 call." 2) Latency: "We optimize for low tail latency with optimized kernels and routing; typical median <100ms for small prompts on dedicated pools." 3) Private deploys/Security: "We offer VPC & on-prem options + KMS/HSM integrations; see SOC2 brief for details." DM me for a one-page cheat-sheet PDF. :memo:

mina cho: Perfect  that's exactly what I needed. Appreciate everyone :wave:
